nodes.title: SG-4.2.2 · Untrack the tracked node_modules files in game/frontend
nodes.body:
Context: about 15,329 files under game/frontend/node_modules (Phaser, its type-generation tests, .vite/vitest/results.json) are still in the git index although .gitignore already holds node_modules/. Desired behavior: a code-level cleanup untracks them with git rm --cached, and a unit test with mocked file listings fails while any dependency path is tracked. Why: vendored Phaser changes must never appear as tracked changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a mocked tracked-file listing containing node_modules paths, when the guard runs, then it fails naming those paths
- Given a listing with no node_modules paths, when the guard runs, then it passes
- Given the cleanup runs, then it uses git rm --cached only and removes nothing from disk


## Scope
- In scope: Helper, cleanup and guard in game/frontend/src/lib
- In scope: Unit tests with a mocked git runner
- Out of scope: Changing .gitignore
- Out of scope: Running git against the real repo in tests
- Preserve: node_modules content on disk
- Preserve: Existing gitignore helper and tests


## Technical constraints
- Vitest with jsdom in game/frontend; tests live in game/frontend/tests
- Git invoked only through an injected runner


## Definition of done
- All three requirements are implemented and verified


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Cleanup untracks dependency paths with git rm --cached and keeps them on disk
nodes.body:
Context: 15,329 dependency files are tracked. Desired behavior: a cleanup lists tracked files via an injected git runner, filters them, and runs git rm -r --cached for the matching top-level node_modules directories, never deleting from disk. Why: stops vendored files showing as tracked changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given tracked node_modules paths, when cleanup runs, then git is called with rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch -- and the node_modules roots
- Given no tracked node_modules paths, when cleanup runs, then git rm is not called
- Given any call, then no --force or filesystem-deleting argument is passed


## Scope
- In scope: untrackNodeModules with injected GitRunner
- Out of scope: Committing the result
- Preserve: Files on disk


## Technical constraints
- Git args passed as an array, no shell string


## Dependencies
- r1


## Definition of done
- Cleanup exported and unit tested with a fake runner


## Non-functional requirements
- Batch roots, not one call per file, so it stays fast with 15,000 files


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A guard fails while any dependency path is tracked
nodes.body:
Context: need a regression guard. Desired behavior: guard reads the tracked listing through the injected runner and throws an Error naming the offending paths when any exist. Why: fails the suite if node_modules is ever tracked again.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a mocked listing with a node_modules path, when the guard runs, then it throws naming that path
- Given a clean mocked listing, when the guard runs, then it resolves without error


## Scope
- In scope: assertNoTrackedNodeModules
- Out of scope: Real git calls in tests
- Preserve: Existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Uses the same injected runner as the cleanup


## Dependencies
- r1


## Definition of done
- Guard exported and unit tested

nodes.summary: Cleanup runs git rm --cached on node_modules roots
nodes.description: Add GitRunner type and untrackNodeModules to the same module; it lists files via git ls-files and untracks node_modules roots from the index only.
acceptance_criteria: Calls git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch -- <roots>
Skips git rm when nothing is tracked

steps.action: Export type GitRunner = (args: string[]) => Promise<string>. Export async untrackNodeModules(git): call git(['ls-files']), split on newline, filter with trackedNodeModulesPaths, derive unique roots as the path prefix up to and including the first node_modules segment, and if any roots exist call git(['rm','-r','--cached','--ignore-unmatch','--',...roots]); return the roots array.
steps.expected: Roots returned; git rm invoked once with --cached
